semantic.justification: Native Markdown filter path for represented Writer content; complete upstream parity remains unverified. InsertHtmlData now uses the original SAL UTF16-to-UTF8 conversion and existing SvStream, passing the real Markdown SwDoc and borrowed SwPaM to the consumed native SwHTMLParser. The private document callback begins at a blank paragraph at section EOF; unconsumed SwReader/Sfx media orchestration is not recreated as a generic API prerequisite. Empty path/baseURL and ignored parser result follow the pinned Markdown caller, and EndHtmlBlock clears its buffer after successful insertion. Actual native HTML/model/worker-codec tests replace the unsupported-placeholder fixture. This is initial connected HTML body/inline/block coverage, not full CSS/named-style/font/link/list/table HTML support. S3HW1E HTML56: SwDoc::InsertTable now forwards the required fifth horizontal orientation and original null-autoformat/column-position/called-from-shell/new-model/final-name argument order. Flat construction preserves source column-count admission (NONE requires one extra endpoint), source direction, direct page attributes and shell-only paragraph adjustment; SwTable stores the source model flag. The actual document records numeric insertion history; undo destroys native table frames, corrects marks and global cursor rings to EndOfPostIts, transfers live table page attributes and deletes the actual section. Redo requires an actual edit shell, uses original false/true flag defaults and restores the saved name separately (WRITER338); the existing browser initial-operation bridge retains first-execution shell semantics and cell-style adjuncts without pretending they are SwTableAutoFormat. Markdown supplies native FULL. Regression evidence is scoped to admitted flat tables and actual document/shell ownership. Non-null native autoformat, redlines, DDE, full old-model algorithms, recursive HTML table construction/layout, RTF direction export and final format/UI audit remain unverified or required. Whole module contract/default/behavior statuses remain unverified; browser file/autosave/recovery deviations are unchanged. S3HW1E HTML59: native InsertTable now admits connected text in actual sections/cells, returns original null for the inserts/footnote node interval before any undo or mutation, and exposes that nullable result through SwDoc and current MDTable pointer contracts. New SwNode.GetTableBox resolves actual enclosing cell ownership. Original tblrwcl.cxx base-line/leaf predecessor algorithms live in their source responsibility, including null-search leaf identity, row-local mode and empty previous rows; actual owning lines are resolved from the real current flat graph, with no alternate owner list. Anonymous nested-line boxes and their original upper hierarchy are not represented or certified. Nested break transfer now copies parent direct page/break items only at the source first-paragraph/first-cell boundary, retains parent items (WRITER340), and does not move following paragraph items for a nested insertion. Existing used-format lookup includes actual table owners in every section instead of only direct body UI blocks. GetUniqueTableName uses the native bitmap and actual o3tl integer suffix conversion (WRITER341), retaining the current English used-format profile; mail merge, localization and unused/default native format-registry owners are not represented or certified. Production history/Markdown consumers retain nullable inputs without inventing a fallback table; native admitted valid pointers remain actual owners. Whole native module/API/ABI/default/lifetime parity is unverified. Structural nontext admission, default SwTable/early-frame bootstrap, full anonymous/nested table rendering/materialization/layout, first-cell HTML orchestration/grammar, RTF direction export, MDTable parser registration/lifetime and final format/UI audit remain required. Browser file/autosave/recovery deviations stay unchanged. S3HW1E HTML60: real Markdown table cursors register a borrowed parser pointer and deregister on explicit source destruction; replacing the active cursor registers the new owner before releasing the old one. EndTable executes the original forward default-character PaM movement, AM_SPACE append and cursor release order, retaining the extra body paragraph (WRITER343). The extracted forward Chars path uses the real SAL OUString code-point primitive from the original non-SKIPCELL Unicode branch, then actual GoNextPos/CheckNodesRange at node boundaries, retaining mark and clearing label affinity even on failure. This does not implement or certify the complete movement function-table, locale/grapheme/word/hidden-content service. Original parser defaults are blockQuoteDepth=-1 and noParSpace=true; outer quote exit restores body style. Popped unique-owned span items and remaining parser items are explicitly disposed before borrowed caller document/cursor owners. Real md4c rejection in a footnote section preserves the nullable table precondition (WRITER342), without claiming native crash reachability. Whole parser reference counting, paste reader, native table/HTML materialization/layout/grammar, RTF direction and final format/UI audit remain unverified; intentional save/open/autosave/recovery behavior is unchanged. HTML60 also selects the real cell start plus one node, preserves the checked four-entry adjustMap contract and exposes active cursor/actual row-box pointer preconditions instead of silently swallowing invalid callback states. Native invalid-pointer/index undefined behavior is not simulated or certified; actual md4c callback producers remain the supported domain.
